# Diz Eden

> Luxury short-stay serviced apartments in East Legon, Accra, Ghana. Two apartment
> types available for direct booking: a 1-Bedroom Luxury Suite and a 2-Bedroom Luxury
> Residence, both with premium amenities and secure online payment via Paystack.

## Property

- 1-Bedroom Luxury Suite: 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, up to 2 guests, GH₵1,200/night.
- 2-Bedroom Luxury Residence: 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, up to 4 guests, GH₵1,800/night.
- Location: East Legon, Accra, Ghana.
- Amenities: King-sized beds, en-suite bathrooms, gourmet kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi,
  Smart TV with Netflix, air conditioning, 24/7 security, private parking, daily
  housekeeping.
